features.name: Customer questionnaire on website
features.description: A questionnaire on the partner's website where prospects fill in answers about their interests, current systems, and company size. The answers are collected and used to customize their trial experience.

features.name: System table storage of questionnaire answers
features.description: Questionnaire responses are stored in a system table inside Business Central before sign-in, allowing the app to pivot and add more things to the experience based on customer answers.

features.name: Dynamic AppSource app loading based on customer profile
features.description: Different AppSource apps and solutions can be loaded dynamically during trial setup based on the combination of answers from the customer questionnaire, enabling targeted onboarding experiences.

features.name: Customer role center assignment before sign-in
features.description: A customer role center can be loaded and attached to a role, then set for the current user before they sign in, providing a customized first experience tailored to their profile.

features.name: Welcome banner personalization
features.description: The welcome banner text can be changed to greet customers with the most relevant greeting and messaging based on their profile, as the first thing they see in Business Central.

features.name: Onboarding checklist tasks
features.description: Checklist tasks serve as the primary stage to lead customers through their first experience, including videos, setup steps, and calls to action. Partners can customize the checklist to guide customers toward features relevant to their profile.
caveats: Checklist is meant to be an example and inspiration, not a comprehensive template

features.name: Assisted setup with custom categories
features.description: The assisted setup list page can be filtered to show only custom setup elements relevant to a solution, allowing partners to guide customers through module-specific configuration steps without overwhelming them with options.

features.name: Teaching tips with markdown support
features.description: Teaching tips can include markdown formatting for bold and italics, and can contain links to other pages, providing guided education to users about features and data they encounter.

features.name: Report request page teaching tips
features.description: Teaching tips can appear on report request pages to educate users about what the report shows, why it exists, and how to best filter it for optimal results.

features.name: Excel layouts for reports
features.description: Partners can provide Excel layout files with reports out of the box, including graphs and formatting. When the report is printed, the data is updated and graphs automatically refresh, giving customers rich reports without manual work.

features.name: Spotlight tour for Excel and Teams integration
features.description: Spotlight tours can highlight core integrations like edit in Excel and share to Teams on custom entities, generating excitement about standard capabilities and how they apply to specific data.

features.name: Teaching tips on query objects in analysis mode
features.description: Teaching tips can be added to query objects to educate users about what analysis they are seeing when they open a query directly from another page, explaining the purpose and meaning of the data.

features.name: Analysis duplication and link sharing
features.description: Users can duplicate an analysis query to create a new version with a different name, and copy a link to share specific analysis with colleagues via Teams or email so they can access the exact analysis.

features.name: Onboarding sample app on GitHub
features.description: Microsoft provides an onboarding sample app on GitHub that partners can fork and use as a template for building their own customer onboarding experiences, including event subscriptions and integration patterns.
